svg.text: K6b LOOSE WARE + FAST WASHER, improved
One hanging-mast gantry with one roll axis; GN trays and pots; a press, two turning rings, a spindle; one quiet well for ware and dishes.
1855 × 600 × 2200 mm (hatch 280, bench + well 345, hob 600, oven + store 580)
≈ 13.5 k€ ± 30 % · ≈ 50 L, 3.5 kWh per 2-person meal incl. dishes
transport gallery (not K6b), box hatch above zone A
dry box: X rails + belt, purge fan, 3 cameras; labyrinth slot below
TOP VIEW at deck level (rear wall at top)
1 Opened box is lowered onto the box shelf in zone A
2 Chuck tips it sideways into the press tube; load pins weigh
3 Press swings over the tube on its legs and dices into the pot
4 Pot slid along the flush deck onto T1; ring turns, scraper stands
5 Frikadellen on the thermoplate; turned by the hooked pair
6 Drop door slides into the plinth; tray slides into the oven
7 Plated in the hatch drawer; chuck rinsed in the jet gate
8 After hand-over: lid up, ware hung in the well, washed ≥ 82 °C

g.text: 1/8 Box in: the transport lowers an opened box through the ceiling hatch onto the passive shelf in zone A
2/8 Dose: the chuck takes the box by its lug and rolls it sideways over the press tube; the load pins stop at the weight
3/8 Dice: the press column rises, its helical cam swings the arm over the tube; 3 kN pull-down; dice fall into the pot below
4/8 Cook: the full pot is slid on the flush deck onto T1; the ring turns it, a scraper hooked to the rear wall stirs
5/8 Fry and turn: Frikadellen on a thermoplate over H2/H4; a second plate is hooked on and the pair rolls over
6/8 Oven: its drop door slides down into the plinth; the tray slides from the bridge straight in, nothing swings
7/8 Serve: plates are filled in the heated hatch drawer; the diner pulls it out; after soiled grips the chuck passes the jet gate
8/8 Wash: the bench lid stands up as a splash screen, ware hangs tang-up in the comb; wash 60 °C, rinse 88 °C, then to the store
